svg.text: Conjectured webs for the Standard Model particles
Each web is a network the Chain Theory compendium (release 0.1) constructs: each site a qudit, each line a maximally entangled pair.
That a web is the named particle is a conjecture.
read line: the W is read along one line, the Z along two
The W and the Z are one web; what distinguishes them is the read. The layouts are for legibility and carry no content.
Each web's standing line, naming the boxes it rests on, is in the compendium's chapter of genres and webs.
